name: Sagility Ltd
about: Incorporated in July 2021, Sagility India Limited (formerly Berkmeer India Pvt. Ltd)  provides healthcare-focused technology-enabled solutions and services primarily to U.S.-based clients in the payer and provider segments.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Share [1] Headquartered in Bangalore, the company serves only US customers. It holds 1.23% of the U.S. healthcare outsourcing market as of 2023.
Client Segmentation[2] 
   - Payers: Health insurance companies that finance and reimburse healthcare services. Sagility provides them with services like claims processing, payment integrity, and clinical management.
   - Providers: Hospitals, physicians, and diagnostic centers, with services focused on revenue cycle management (RCM) that includes insurance verification, billing, and accounts receivable follow-up.

cons: Stock is trading at 2.65 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 4.89% over last 3 years.
